display.purpose: Instrument Serif, the trade-verdict headline and its italic 'beat/vs' connector only. One gloat per page.

headline.purpose: Extrabold tracking-tight Geist Sans for page-hero names; the 34px franchise letter is a variant of this voice.

title.purpose: 13-14px semibold/bold tracking-tight Geist Sans for card and section titles.

body.purpose: 12-13px Geist Sans prose - explainers, stories, blurbs. Max 65-75ch for prose; tables run wider.

data.purpose: 11-12px Geist Mono with tabular-nums (.tabular) for every metric cell, rating, record, and date.

label.purpose: 9-10px uppercase Geist Mono, letter-spaced 0.05-0.1em, Pencil Gray. Column headers, state tags, captions.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Portaled tooltips and floating menus only - the sole blurred shadow. Never on surfaces in page flow.

shadows.name: frozen-column-mask
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur solid paint faking a surface fill + 1px divider edge on the pinned owner column of scrolled tables.

shadows.name: you-row-marker
shadows.purpose: 3px inset Verdict Violet bar flagging the signed-in user's row in standings.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.keyframes: @keyframes panel-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-3px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
motion.purpose: Disclosure reveal for expanding breakdown panels (rating receipts, GM breakdowns).

motion.name: tip-in
motion.purpose: Tooltip fade - opacity only, positioning transform lives in inline style.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Default Tailwind transition for hover color/opacity/transform state feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> all animation/transition durations forced to 0.01ms
motion.purpose: Global neutralizer in globals.css; every animation must survive being instant.

breakpoints.name: note
breakpoints.value: Tailwind defaults - no custom screens; responsive behavior is structural (frozen-column horizontal swipe on tables, nav folding into a More menu).

components.name: Card
components.description: The universal container: Clean Sheet on 1px Hairline, 10px radius, flat per The Hairline Rule.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--divider); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 2px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary button: Ink on Paper, 4px radius, opacity hover - The One Ink Button Rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ringfocus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Year Tabs
components.description: Mono tab strip on a Hairline baseline; active tab is Ink bold with a 2px Ink underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider); } .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: var(--dim); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ringfocus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: The signature data-table row: mono tabular figures, signed outcome colors, whole-row hover link.
components.html: 3Hammer Dan+1,204-38.50
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 80px 80px 56px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider); font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: var(--bg); } .ds-ledger-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ringfocus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-ledger-rank { font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); } .ds-ledger-owner { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger-num { text-align: right; } .ds-pos { color: var(--pos); font-weight: 600; } .ds-neg { color: var(--neg); font-weight: 600; } .ds-flat { color: var(--dim); }

components.name: Grade Pill
components.description: Letter-grade chip using a full pill triad (bg + border + text from one set, never mixed).
components.css: .ds-grade-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--pill-a-bg); border: 1px solid var(--pill-a-border); color: var(--pill-a-text); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed field: Paper well on a Sheet card, Hairline border, ring focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--divider); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--dim); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ringfocus); }

components.css: @keyframes ds-tip-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } .ds-tooltip { width: 224px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--divider); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); animation: ds-tip-in 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tooltip-stats { margin-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--divider); padding-top: 6px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--dim); } .ds-tooltip-you { color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Vital Tile
components.description: The sanctioned stat tile: flat Paper well, bold tabular value over a whisper caption. Not a SaaS hero-metric card.
components.css: .ds-vital { min-width: 72px; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--divider); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: center; } .ds-vital-value { font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-vital-label { margin-top: 2px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--dim); }

narrative.overview:
This interface is a ledger, not a dashboard. Every claim on screen is a line item with receipts: a signed number, set in monospace, drawn on paper-toned ground between hairline rules, one click away from the evidence beneath it. The argument in the group chat ends here because the numbers close it — a trade reads "104 vs 56," a franchise reads "B · 1580 · #3 of 12," and tapping anything opens the full accounting down to the signal that added or cost the points. The visual language serves that job: near-black ink on warm near-white paper, Geist Mono carrying every figure, dividers doing the work that boxes and shadows do elsewhere, and a single serif verdict line allowed to gloat at the top of a trade page.

The register is product, the temperament is Linear/Vercel: fast, high-contrast, monospace-accented, every element deliberate. Density is a feature — twelve-column standings grids, per-player stat sheets, expandable contribution breakdowns — but density is held to restraint: tight paddings, whisper-quiet uppercase labels, chrome that disappears behind the numbers. This system explicitly rejects the cluttered, ad-stuffed, gradient-and-gloss mainstream fantasy UI of ESPN and Yahoo; it is not a reskin of the Sleeper app's own visual language; and it refuses the generic SaaS dashboard — the card-grid + hero-metric template + purple gradient admin panel — even though it happens to own a violet. The violet here is a gavel, not a gradient.

Both themes are first-class. Light is the default (paper and ink); dark inverts to near-black ground with the same hairline discipline, and every semantic color re-tunes for contrast rather than merely inverting. WCAG AA is the floor in both.
keyCharacteristics: Tabular, monospace-accented, drillable — every number is a receipt
Flat and divider-drawn: hairline rules and a one-step tonal ladder, never shadows on surfaces
Terse components with tight paddings; data-first, chrome-last
Signed numbers colored by outcome (green up, red down, gray flat)
One accent — Verdict Violet — reserved for the ruling, links, and selection
Light default + dark toggle, both AA-clean

rules.name: The Verdict Violet Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the ruling: links, current selection, the "You" marker, the decisive interactive element. It never fills a hero, never tints a card, never gradients. If Verdict Violet covers more than a badge's worth of any screen, it is being misused.

rules.name: The Signed Number Rule
rules.body: Win Green and Loss Red belong to signed outcomes only — +1,204 is green, −312 is red, 0/— is Pencil Gray, and the sign character is always rendered. Labels, headers, and chrome never wear the semantic colors. A colored word is a lie; a colored number is a receipt.

rules.name: The Token Gate Rule
rules.body: Every color on screen comes from a --token in globals.css, in both themes. Hard-coded hex in a component is prohibited — it silently breaks dark mode. If a hue has no token, propose the token first.

rules.name: The Mono Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every number is Geist Mono with tabular figures. Sans-serif digits in a data column are forbidden — if two rows' numbers don't align vertically, the type is wrong.

rules.name: The Serif Verdict Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is the verdict voice and only the verdict voice: the trade-story headline and the "beat/vs" connector. It is prohibited in navigation, labels, buttons, tables, and any UI chrome. One gloat per page.

rules.name: The Whisper Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata whispers: 9–10px uppercase mono, letter-spaced, Pencil Gray. Labels never compete with the figures they caption — if a header reads louder than its column, shrink the header, don't grow the data.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth is drawn, not cast. Surfaces get 1px --divider borders and the bg→surface tonal step; blurred shadows are prohibited on anything in page flow. If a card looks like it's floating, it's wrong — cards in a ledger lie flat on the page.

rules.name: The Row Is the Receipt Rule
rules.body: In any table, the whole row is the interactive unit — it links to the drill-down, hovers to Ledger Paper, and expands to the breakdown. Buttons inside rows are for secondary actions only; never make the user hunt for a 12px "view" link.

rules.name: The One Ink Button Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one primary button: Ink on Paper, 4px radius, opacity hover. Any screen needing a "more important" button than that is making an argument the numbers should be making.

dos: Do draw every color from a globals.css token (var(--pos), not #15803d) so both themes stay correct — The Token Gate Rule.
Do set every number in Geist Mono with .tabular (tabular-nums), signed where signable (+1,204 / −312), colored by outcome per The Signed Number Rule.
Do build depth from 1px Hairline (#e5e5e0) borders and the Paper→Sheet tonal step (#fafaf7 → #ffffff); keep surfaces flat per The Hairline Rule.
Do use the five-metric vocabulary exactly: Trade Value / Total Points / Regular Season Points / Playoff Points / Toilet Bowl Points — consistent across engine, API, and UI.
Do keep labels whispering: 9–10px uppercase Geist Mono, letter-spaced 0.05–0.1em, Pencil Gray (#6b6b6b).
Do make whole rows the link, with hover:bg-bg and a drill-down behind every figure — receipts over opinions.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (the global neutralizer already exists) and keep motion at 120–200ms state feedback (tip-in 120ms, panel-in 200ms) — never choreography.
Do let tables swipe horizontally on phones with frozen identity columns, instead of amputating columns.
donts: Don't ever render the string "KTC" in the UI — it is "Trade Value" or "Value", always. This ban extends to LLM output (the sanitizer exists for a reason).
Don't build toward ESPN / Yahoo fantasy: their cluttered, ad-stuffed, gradient-and-gloss mainstream fantasy UI is the opposite of this system. No gloss, no badge soup, no promo tiles.
Don't borrow the Sleeper app's own visual language — this is a distinct analysis layer, not a reskin of Sleeper.

Don't ship the generic SaaS dashboard: the card-grid + hero-metric template + purple gradient admin panel is prohibited slop. Verdict Violet (#7c3aed) is never a gradient, never a hero fill — if a screen leads with three big rounded metric cards, start over.
Don't put box-shadows on cards, rows, or anything in page flow. The only sanctioned shadow is shadow-lg on portaled overlays (tooltips, menus).

Don't hard-code chart or status colors — it breaks dark mode silently. Use --playoff/--warn/--window (the contention-window pill in StandingsTable.tsx, the writer swatch in LlmCostPanel.tsx, and the playoff band/label in ProductionTimeline.tsx all read from tokens).
Don't color words with Win Green / Loss Red — semantic color belongs to signed numbers and single-letter grades only.
Don't use Instrument Serif anywhere but the trade verdict and its "beat/vs" connector; no display type in labels, buttons, or data.
Don't add spinners mid-content or block the page on load — dashboards skeleton (DashboardSkeleton), lists dim to 60% opacity while refreshing.

Don't add cold-onboarding scaffolding, empty-state marketing, or explainer walls — the audience is 10–12 insiders who already know the league. Explain via collapsed disclosures and tooltips, not banners.
